.`RED when only 8 of 10 fiscal years are positive (2 loss years)`()
.`INDETERMINATE when only 8 fiscal year records are available (less than 10)`()

.`GREEN when 12 records present but top-10 most-recent all positive (2 oldest discarded)`()
.`RED not triggered when 2 oldest of 12 records are losses (outside the 10-year window)`()
.`ruleId is EARNINGS_STABILITY_10Y for all signal outcomes`()
.`threshold label contains GREEN and YELLOW markers`()
